limitations: CPU uses server utime+stime over enclosing samples and excludes waited-child CPU; process I/O may include reaped children.
RSS is sampled owned-family sum; shared mappings may be counted more than once.
Physical WAL length is sampled by passive filesystem stat, not endpoint size or backlog frames.
No confidence interval claim; all six paired observations are retained.
Sampling gaps from confirmed exited/reused processes are retained per case; a final descendant I/O sample may be unavailable, and no metrics are fabricated.
